source_type: own release (NCBI); sentence-level BLURB/Crichton test file downloaded as a cross-check of the ClinicBench count
revision: NCBI zip (no versioning; file dated 2012-11-07); GitHub cambridgeltl/MTL-Bioinformatics-2016 df0df02fae6dbb87d88ffcf323b9096528f06f84
license: US Government work, public domain (NCBI disclaimer page)
split: official test set (100 abstracts); 940 sentences in the BLURB/Crichton IOB version
single_request: yes (via ClinicBench prompt template; raw corpus is token-level NER)
request_fields: ClinicBench Table 8 NER prompt ("Paragraph: <id> | <text> Please extract all diseases...") + sentence text
notes: ClinicBench (Liu et al., EMNLP 2024; github.com/AI-in-Health/ClinicBench @57138be8a73f09bef8980f849789baf57570c5cf) releases only its six new datasets; existing datasets are not redistributed, so the own release was used. Official test set: 100 PubMed abstracts with 960 disease mentions. ClinicBench Table 1 reports 940 items, which equals the number of sentences in the BLURB/Crichton IOB test file, so n_items = 940 (sentence-level). Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.
